0022600104.text: The Miami Heat (0-2, on a two-game losing streak, fifth in the Southeast and 15th in the East) visit the Charlotte Hornets (1-1, third in the Southeast and eighth in the East) for the Heat's third game of the season. Charlotte is missing Kylan Boswell, who is out after knee surgery, while Coby White, Grant Williams, and Kon Knueppel are all day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, with calf strain and hamstring issues. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Miami won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, though it lost the most recent meeting 136-106 in Charlotte on March 17, 2026.
